name: ECS Task Definition Backdoor
description: An attacker with ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition creates a new task definition that uses a malicious container image or overrides the entrypoint to run attacker code. When ecs:UpdateService deploys this task definition to a service, the attacker's code runs in the cluster with the task role's permissions. The attacker can exfiltrate credentials, access AWS resources, or establish persistence. Required permissions are ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition and ecs:UpdateService. The task role may have broad permissions if not properly scoped.
